Mitchell Marsh nearly withdrew from ODI due to mental strain over Bancroft's claims: Report   
 Menu English हिन्दी Categories For the best experience use inshorts app on your smartphone Mitchell Marsh nearly withdrew from ODI due to mental strain over Bancroft's claims: Report  
 short by Anmol Sharma / 08:22 pm on Thursday, 19 November 2026 Australia white-ball captain Mitchell Marsh nearly withdrew from third ODI against England due to mental strain over Cameron Bancroft's Sandpapergate revelations, a report said. Bancroft alleged Marsh and other Australian bowlers knew about the 2018 ball-tampering scandal and provided feedback on reverse swing. Marsh eventually played the ODI but skipped post-match press conference. read more at CricTracker Inshorts Pte. Ltd.
